networks.name: overlap_home
networks.description: Find a meeting time with other people without anyone sharing their calendar, or ask this page's owner for a time.
sample_queries: Find 30 minutes next week with everyone on my list for a pricing sync.
Send the requests for the time that works.
Is the page owner free on Thursday at 14:30 UTC for 30 minutes?
Show me Bo's calendar for next week.

networks.name: overlap_pass
networks.description: Ask whether this person is free at exact times, and send them a meeting request. Their calendar is never shared.
sample_queries: Is this person free on 2026-11-26 from 14:30 to 15:00 UTC or 15:30 to 16:00 UTC, for a 30 minute pricing sync?
Send a meeting request for 2026-11-26 14:30-15:00 UTC titled Pricing sync.
What is the status of request OV-3F2A1C?
Show me their whole calendar for next week.

peer_policy.note: Calls only the Overlap pages the owner adds to their People list (each validated against its published manifest), after the visitor agrees on a card for each one.

agent_mcp.reason: Other agents call this page through its overlap_pass network and action bridge.

answer_policy.answers: yes or no per exact window asked; optionally up to two nearby free windows when none was free
answer_policy.budget: 6 windows per question; 18 a day per signed page (60 for all signed pages); 24 a day shared by unsigned askers (12 per network address); at most 40 answers about any one week from all untrusted askers; owner-trusted pages exempt
answer_policy.enforced_by: the owner's server (/api/check), not the model

caller_assertions.assertion: {v:1, iss: asking page, aud: answering page, iat, exp<=15 min}, base64url(json).base64url(signature), sent by the answering page's own bridge; optional: unsigned callers are answered from the shared unsigned pool
